claims.claim: Claude Code eksponuje MCP tools pod wzorcem `mcp__<server-name>__<tool-name>`, double underscore literal.
Permissions patterns uzywaja tego prefixu: permissions.deny: ['mcp__untrusted__*'] dla blocking.
Top symptom A: server connected ale zero tools w /mcp menu. Root cause issue #11175 - server deklaruje tools capability ale tools/list zwraca pusty array.
Symptom B: connection fail 'server unavailable' (issue #1611). Root causes: binary not in PATH, SSL cert issue, firewall, server crash silent.
Symptom C: dziala w Claude Desktop nie w Claude Code CLI (issue #72, #12086). Root: rozne config paths (Desktop: claude_desktop_config.json vs Code: ~/.claude/settings.json).
Symptom D: timeout pomimo config (#20335, #3033, #44032).
Symptom E: silent failure, Claude nie uzywa tool. Root: description za dlugie/za krotkie, name collision z built-in, prompt injection w description, permissions deny wygral.
Standard debug flow: (1) claude mcp list, (2) MCP Inspector standalone, (3) sprawdz logs, (4) restart sesji, (5) minimal config izolacja.
MCP Inspector command: `npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector <command>` -> http://localhost:5173 GUI.
Logs locations: Claude Desktop macOS ~/Library/Logs/Claude/, Windows %APPDATA%\Claude\logs\, Linux ~/.config/Claude/logs/. Claude Code: ~/.claude/logs/.
DevTools Claude Desktop: Cmd-Opt-I (macOS) / Ctrl-Alt-I (Windows). Claude Code CLI nie ma DevTools.
Reddit pattern: po update Claude Code (npm update -g) serwery przestaja dzialac. Fix: claude mcp remove + add na nowo.
Reddit pattern: /mcp pokazuje server ale tools zero - czeka na auth OAuth (pierwsze tools/list zwraca pusty, po auth complete widac tools).
Power-user pattern A: personal MCP per projekt z domain context (product schema, recent orders, design tokens).
Power-user pattern B: MCP jako config vector dla live preferences - 90% use cases Skill lepszy.
Power-user pattern C: MCP aggregator gateway (Rube, docker/mcp-gateway, Zapier MCP) - jedna connection dla 500+ tools.
Most adopted production pattern D: CLAUDE.md (project context) + 2-3 MCP servers + 5-10 Skills + 5-20 Commands.
CI/CD (GitHub Actions) issue #647: 'permission denied for MCP'. Fix: enableAllProjectMcpServers: true w workflow env (trade-off akceptowany dla headless).
CI/CD mitigation: pinnowac exact versions serwerow (npx -y package@X.Y.Z zamiast @latest).
Tool availability dependent on auth: pierwsze tools/list na OAuth server zwraca pusty array dopoki auth complete. Workaround: claude mcp auth <server> + restart.
Naming collisions: gdy MCP tool name koliduje z built-in (np. Read, Bash), built-in wygrywa. Workaround: rename w serverze.
Claude Code CLI --debug flag: pokazuje pelny log JSON-RPC traffic miedzy Claude a serwerami.
Anti-patterns reddit: (1) install everything awesome-mcp, (2) enableAll w OSS repo, (3) no restart po config change, (4) mix Desktop/Code config, (5) vague tool descriptions.
Debug community tools: mcpcat.io (SaaS logs), glama.ai (directory+helpers), mcp-inspector (oficjalny), context-mode (sandbox wrapper).
Known long-standing open bugs 2026-04-17: #424 (timeout configurable), #11364 (lazy-load), #20335 (HTTP timeout), #44032 (Windows 4min), #15945 (no stuck detection), #12086 (external not loading).
